block.guhs.guhstation.lore: A gray-black game console with a guh snoot on it. It smells a little of sea air and wet dog
block.guhs.guhstation.tooltip: Put it down and click it: that's how you go back to Sniff Island
item.guhs.snuffel_geheugenkaart.lore: Everything your nose has learned is on here. A dog never misplaces it
item.guhs.snuffel_geheugenkaart.tooltip: Use it to save and go home
item.guhs.snuffel_bloesemtakje: Blossom Twig from Your Little Tree
item.guhs.snuffel_bloesemtakje.lore: Your buddy's little tree gave it to you to take along. It smells of Sniff Island, nyeg
gui.guhs.snuffel.maatje.a.tekst: A little ball of seed fluff with a seed underneath and a leaf for a sail. Drifts along on the wind and steers with the leaf; light and airy, easy to spot against grass.
gui.guhs.snuffel.maatje.b.tekst: A little acorn with its cap pulled low over its eyes, a tuft of moss and two twig arms. Can point and wave with the twigs; the cap bobs along when it's up to something.
gui.guhs.snuffel.maatje.c.tekst: A glowing little dandelion head with petals all around and a curly tail. Gives off light (handy in the dark) and leaves a trail of fluffy sparks.
gui.guhs.snuffel.post_wacht: %s more things from the island are waiting for a free spot in your pockets
gui.guhs.snuffel.post_mee: %s x %s comes home with you. A dog has no pockets, nyeg
gui.guhs.snuffel.aangespoeld: The waves wash you back ashore on the island. Nyeg, what a splash
gui.guhs.snuffel.stroming: The current is too strong here. Better swim back to the island
gui.guhs.snuffel.regels.poten: You can't build or break with pawsies. But you can sniff and dig, nyeg
gui.guhs.snuffel.reis.geen_eiland: Sniff Island can't be reached right now
gui.guhs.snuffel.reis.spel_bezig: Finish your game first, then you can go to the island
gui.guhs.snuffel.reis.even_wachten: Just a teeny bit longer, nyeg
gui.guhs.snuffel.reis.thuis: Home again, right where you were. All your things are still here. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.snuffel.meter.dichtbij: Very close! Keep sniffing a bit... (%s)
gui.guhs.snuffel.graaf_niets: Nothing here. Just sand between your toes, nyeg
gui.guhs.snuffel.geur_geleerd: New scent in your sniff book: %s (%s). You now know %s scents. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.snuffel.rang.omhoog: Your nose has grown! You are now a %s. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.snuffel.boom.groeit.1: A little sprout is coming up by the ring of stones!
gui.guhs.snuffel.boom.groeit.2: The little sprout has become a shoot!
gui.guhs.snuffel.boom.groeit.3: The shoot has become a little bush!
gui.guhs.snuffel.boom.groeit.4: The little bush has become a young tree. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.snuffel.examen.start: %s begins: sniff out the %s scents. Take your time, there's no such thing as failing, nyeg
gui.guhs.snuffel.guhstation.onbekend: The little screen stays black. This little box belongs to Sniff Island: first find a dock cottage by the water, nyeg
gui.guhs.snuffel.guhstation.nee: No, I'd rather not sniff right now, nyeg
gui.guhs.snuffel.toets.kaart: Memory card: save and go home
gui.guhs.snuffel.keuze.kop_maatje: Which buddy is coming with you?
gui.guhs.snuffel.keuze.alleen_jij: Your buddy is a forest sprite that only you can see.
gui.guhs.snuffel.boekje.later: Ranks 2 through 5 come in a later story
gui.guhs.snuffel.boekje.leeg: Nothing yet. Hold down the sniff key and follow your nose, nyeg
quest.guhs.snuffel.bewoner.hallo: Woof! Er, I mean: nyeg! Lovely weather for sniffing, isn't it?
quest.guhs.snuffel.kapitein.vraag: Ahoy, landlubber! My little boat is all ready. Shall I sail you back home? You'll land right where you came from, with all your things. And the island isn't going anywhere, nyeg.
quest.guhs.snuffel.kapitein.geen_hond: Ahoy! You don't look like a dog. How did you wash up here, nyeg?
gui.guhs.snuffel.geur.deegroller: A rolling pin covered in dough
gui.guhs.snuffel.geur.dobber: A bobber that smells of fish
gui.guhs.snuffel.geur.stuiterbal: A bouncy ball covered in drool
gui.guhs.snuffel.daad.oma_bolwol: returned Granny Woolly's ball of wool
gui.guhs.snuffel.daad.tuinder_gietertje: returned Gardener Turnip's little watering can
